- Predicted curved objects roll in 5 of 8 unaided attempts.
- Identified an orange, drum, wheel, and laddoo as round or curved examples.
- Identified a flat box as able to slide and stack.
- Continued to say only balls can roll; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised sorting objects by curved or flat surfaces and discussing whether they roll, slide, or stack. Anika used the orange, wheel, and laddoo examples to connect curved surfaces with rolling, and identified that a flat box can slide and stack. They still mixed up the idea that only balls roll, and this was not corrected after the last time it appeared. At home, gently test a ball, bottle, orange, and can by rolling each one and noticing that objects besides balls can roll.
